source.citation: Live capture against the A4H sandbox appliance (SID A4H, client 001) on 2026-08-11 at 2026-08-11T13:05:23Z. Raw capture artifacts (session scratchpad, not committed): wire39b/err_nosuchtable.body (500 B, sha256 d9a084db41158ae2feb47acbc7cf373fe664277f1e485369bae010ebae77ef6d), wire39b/err_nosuchtable.hdr (verbatim response status line + headers), wire39b/err_nosuchtable.json (request sidecar), produced by wire39b/cap.sh.
source.notes: POST /sap/bc/adt/datapreview/ddic?rowNumber=3&ddicEntityName=ZZNOSUCHTABLE, empty request body. The error envelope for an unknown DDIC entity: HTTP 400 (not 404), content-type application/xml (NOT the datapreview vendor type the request asked for), <exc:exception> with <type id="ExceptionDataPreviewGeneral"/> and a human message. The type id is the SAME generic id used for every other datapreview failure, so failure classification cannot key on it and must key on the <message> text ('Table/View X not found') — this cassette is what pins the NOT_FOUND classification to bytes rather than to a guess. Anonymisation: appliance.server is the repo's standing pseudonym for the A4H ApplicationServerName. The appliance's real host name and its container IPv4 are deliberately absent from this file, as is the appliance URL; Authorization / Cookie / X-CSRF-Token request-header values are replaced with placeholders. Response bytes are unmodified. kernelRelease/kernelPatchLevel were read live from GET /sap/bc/adt/system/information on the same day as this capture, not copied from an earlier cassette.
